verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents threshold-based alerts that notify via Slack, GitHub Actions, or webhooks when a metric crosses a threshold. It also specifically documents alerts when spend crosses a threshold, which covers the cost-spike case and the Slack channel. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that error-rate and eval-score drops are supported alert metrics, native PagerDuty or email channels (only reachable via generic webhooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
